{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:19.762

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:21.682

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:26.543
    | text      = Alex's argument holds any water.The thing that Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:29.751

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:35.811
    | text      = generals, including those in the EPA, Hu-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:38.351
    | text      = Health and Human Services, the Veterans Affairs, State Department, and the Department of Defense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:43.371

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:46.371

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:51.670
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:52.451
    | text      = According to the Inspector General Act of 1978, and updates in the Securing Inspector Generals
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:57.971
    | text      = Act of 2022, there are steps that you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:00.431
    | text      = have to take in order to remove an IG, because if there weren't, then the president or government official
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:06.170
    | text      = would, would d- would have a really easy time covering up corruption.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:09.391
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:09.552

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:11.431

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Corporation for National and Community Service, Gerald Walpin.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
